name: read
description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

name: list_sessions
description: Find Host-visible DSH sessions by title or list them with status, activity time, and working directory, without starting them.

query.description: Optional literal title substring, case-insensitive, 1–500 UTF-16 code units. Works without a full-text index. Omit to list all sessions.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1 through 50. Defaults to 20.

cwd.description: Only sessions whose recorded working directory starts with this absolute path.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same query, cwd, and limit. Restart without it if the listing changes.

name: inspect_session
description: Inspect a session and its source, search events, list tool calls and failures, or read exact raw evidence without starting it. Returns follow-up calls.

session_id.description: Session id from list_sessions or search_sessions.

mode.description: Defaults to outline. Use calls for tool inputs, results and failures, search to find events, or read for readable text and the complete original event.

transcript.description: Only for outline: generate a bounded private text projection for grep. Defaults to false.

query.description: Required for search: word or phrase, 1–500 UTF-16 code units. Uses native literal matching when the full-text index is disabled.

limit.description: Only for search or calls: maximum rows, 1 through 50. Defaults to the smaller of 20 and that maximum. Follow next for calls; narrow search queries when hasMore is true.

from_seq.description: Only for calls: inclusive starting call-event sequence. Defaults to 0; follow next for continuation.

until_seq.description: Only for calls: inclusive capture boundary. Defaults to the observed end; next preserves it across pages.

errors_only.description: Only for calls: return failed outer and nested calls. Defaults to false. Counts always cover the captured prefix.

seq.description: Required for read: nonnegative event sequence from a search hit, call row, or outline.

before.description: Only for read: preceding event summaries, 0–10. Defaults to 2.

after.description: Only for read: following event summaries, 0–10. Defaults to 2.
